title: heze-devnet-0
announcements: heze-devnet-0 targets to launch on the 31st of Aug 2026.

**Scope.** First devnet for [EIP-7805 FOCIL](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7805) on the **Heze** fork. 
Client images build from the common `heze-devnet-0` branch.
[bogota-devnet-0 ](https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/bogota-devnet-0) (EIP-8141) is kept on a separate devnet track.
